! Title: EasyList Sample for KBlock Tests
! Version: 2026102201

! ─── Network Block Rules ───
||pagead2.googlesyndication.com^$third-party
||adservice.google.com^$third-party
||adnxs.com^$script,image
||doubleclick.net^$important
||tracking.example.vn^$domain=example.vn|sub.example.vn
@@||allowed-cdn.example.com^$script

! ─── Element Hide Rules ───
##.google-ad-placeholder
example.vn##div.ad-container
##div[id^="ad-banner-"]
@@||example.com^$generichide

! ─── Unsupported Rules (should be skipped and reported, never corrupting DNR) ───
||popup.example.com^$redirect=noopjs
||badrule.example.com^$badfilter
##+js(set, test, 1)
example.vn##div:has(> a[href*="affiliate"])
